scope: Post-generation literature spot-checks of new ALS seed premises; not exhaustive novelty or claim validation

checks.verified: The primary study reports S606 in a PEST sequence and phosphorylation-dependent modulation of NUP98–APC/C(Cdc20) interaction in cell-cycle experiments.
checks.not_established: This study does not establish an ALS motor-neuron initiation mechanism or an S606-dependent nuclear-pore-retention lesion.
checks.candidate_context: New GPT seeds c001/c004 explicitly label Ser606 selection and neuronal relevance as unverified prior knowledge or assumptions. Do not classify the residue itself as fabricated.

checks.verified: The primary study supports mitotic NUP98 phosphorylation by multiple kinases including CDK1/NEKs and delayed nuclear-pore/envelope disassembly in phosphorylation-deficient mutants.
checks.not_established: It does not establish CDK1-dependent NUP98 phosphorylation as the initiating lesion in post-mitotic ALS motor neurons.
checks.interpretation: A transfer from mitotic cell-cycle biology to ALS neurons remains a speculative bridge.
